description:
Tired of pressing the power button/swiping the screen every time an alarm rings? No worries! With this app, you can simply shake your phone and dismiss the alarm.
Salient features:
• Works offline.
• No advertisements.
• Completely open-source app.
• Alarms are unique by alarm time. This means that you cannot have two alarms at the same time, even if they are on different dates.
• Each alarm is independent of other alarms. This means that the alarm volume, ringtone, etc. will not be carried over to another alarm unless you do so manually.
• Inbuilt dark theme, even in phones that do not support it.
• Snooze your alarm as many times as you want with custom snooze options.
• When updates are released, you will be notified within the app itself.
• The alarm is handled by a service which has almost no dependency on the UI. So, even if your UI freezes, the alarm will ring and can be dismissed.
• Uses latest Android Room database for storing alarms.
• Actively maintained app. Bug reports will be worked upon with high priority.
